xna-type.name: BitmapContent
xna-type.summary: Provides properties and methods for creating and maintaining a bitmap resource.
xna-type.remarks: The BitmapContent class represents a single two-dimensional image with a fixed size and fixed format. Various pixel encodings are supported by subclasses of the bitmap type. Higher level constructs such as textures that may contain multiple mipmap images or cube map faces are stored as collections of multiple bitmaps.

parameters.parameter: Region of destination bitmap to be overwritten.

overload.returns: true if region copy is supported; false otherwise.
overload.remarks: This operation succeeds if the source is a PixelBitmapContent object and the copy region covers all of both bitmaps. Some bitmap subclasses may support subregion copies and/or a wider range of formats than just Vector4 , but this is not required. Copy functionality is accessible using the Copy methods.
